summary: acer aspire 7 gaming has thermal throttling and occasional BSOD due to driver issues, but is a reliable option for gaming laptops within the £1000 budget
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and occasional BSOD due to driver issues with Intel UEFI BIOS version 10.20.1001 and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 drivers version 465.28
suggested_solution: Proper cooling solutions such as the IETS GT600 or Llano V10/V12 coolers can mitigate thermal throttling, while updating drivers to the latest version may resolve BSOD issues
